name: obsidian-cli-mcp-tool-stats
description: Usage stats for the obsidian-cli-mcp server (/cli-mcp-tool-stats): calls, estimated tokens, errors and latency per tool, with hints on heavy results, repeat calls, error patterns and unused schemas, kept across sessions.

server.title: MCP server name
server.description: The server whose tools are tracked, as /mcp lists it

heavyResultTokens.title: Heavy result threshold (tokens)
heavyResultTokens.description: A tool whose results average more than this is flagged as heavy

slowCallMs.title: Slow call threshold (ms)
slowCallMs.description: A tool whose calls average longer than this is flagged as slow

keepHistory.title: Keep history across sessions
keepHistory.description: Saves per-tool totals and error patterns so unused tools and recurring errors show up over time
